_comment: The trailer edit, read by tools/trailer/edit.py. Segments in order; in/out are seconds from the shot's TRAILER_IN mark (tools/trailer/review.sh <shot> shows the frames). fade_in/fade_out dip to the game's paper colour. The music bed is one game track from its start; its hit at 12.55 s is placed on the great tree's colour returning.

segments.note: the grey vale, Orimi small on the shrine path
card: The vale has lost its colour.
runs; the brush stills the world; Slash drawn; the thorns are cut
Bloom drawn round the great camphor; colour floods back (music hit)
the crane ends over the green valley
Bloom on the sapling; the Reed Shallows turn green
dusk Tallowford; Kindle lights Old Trim's lamp; the warm pool spreads; he wakes: Who let my lamp go out?
sealed fight: Orimi steps onto the jetty square, the torn-paper screens rise round it; a Slash
a Splotchet lunges and is struck
the Reedwraith unravels; the screens fall; petals
Tallowford lit, the ford-lamp over the river
